question: Does a local copy rule (model among the splits of the end pair sharing a distinction with the middle pair) decide SEED's copy step exactly?

definitions.CR: model sought among crossed splits separating the end pair that shares a distinction with the middle pair; clause (a) on the end pairs' splits

forbidden_inputs: Changing the rule, starts, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
cheapest_meaningful_control: CRANY (SEED's own clause (b)) must equal SEED.

predictions.P1: CR = SEED on every crossing-making extension
predictions.P2: CRANY = SEED; C1 on every knot set
predictions.P3: most refusals clause (a); among (b) refusals subsets outnumber supersets
predictions.P4: some absorbing fills have a model with >= 2 crossers
predictions.P5: every absorbing fill in the copy class

decision_rules.CR decides: agreement with SEED on every crossing-making extension, no tolerance
